name: @szl-holdings/temporal-tests
description: SZL Holdings Temporal workflow definitions, activities, and unit/replay tests (Phase 10 — Operability & Governance)

scripts.test: node -e "try{require.resolve('@temporalio/testing')}catch{console.log('Temporal SDK not installed, skipping tests');process.exit(0)}" && vitest run --reporter=verbose
scripts.dev:server: node -e "try{require.resolve('@temporalio/testing')}catch{console.log('Temporal testing SDK not installed, exiting');process.exit(0)}" && tsx scripts/dev-server.ts
scripts.worker:start: node -e "try{require.resolve('@temporalio/worker')}catch{console.log('Temporal SDK not installed, exiting');process.exit(0)}" && tsx scripts/start-worker.ts
scripts.worker:smoke: node -e "try{require.resolve('@temporalio/testing')}catch{console.log('Temporal SDK not installed, skipping smoke test');process.exit(0)}" && tsx scripts/smoke-test.ts
scripts.worker:approval:start: node -e "try{require.resolve('@temporalio/worker')}catch{console.log('Temporal SDK not installed, exiting');process.exit(0)}" && tsx scripts/start-approval-worker.ts
scripts.worker:approval:smoke: node -e "try{require.resolve('@temporalio/testing')}catch{console.log('Temporal SDK not installed, skipping smoke test');process.exit(0)}" && tsx scripts/smoke-approval-worker.ts
